title: Hoppers Fill Bundles
description:
Hopper fill and empty bundles when placed in decorated pots.

Dev on all my projects will be paused for the duration of the BDS boycott against Microsoft.
body:
Is manually filling or emptying your bundles too much work? Well, this is the mod for you.

Automate the process of filling up and emptying your bundles with hoppers and decorated pots. 


## Lithium Compatability
Lithium's default settings are incompatable with this mod. To configure Lithium for compatability, add the line `mixin.block.hopper=false` to the `lithium.properties` file in your config folder.
